source.current_site_usage: The UTP Plan current Data Admin site still directs vendors to this Data Policies & Fee Schedule; UTP site in 2026 states pricing is located in UTP Data Policies.

findings.nonprofessional_display_subscriber: $1/month per subscriber under the displayed controlled-product schedule

interpretation: There is no direct-UQDF/UTDF permanent-$0 non-display loophole in the cited current UTP fee basis.

A $0-to-end-user strict G9 path could still exist only if a lawful vendor/broker absorbs upstream licensing costs and explicitly grants the user's automated/non-display API use without balance, activity, per-query, subscription, account-maintenance, or recurring fee conditions.
Retail display access being free-to-user does not prove automated/non-display API entitlement.
Delayed or end-of-day no-fee status does not qualify strict G9 because freshness is mandatory.
policy_effect: NO_THRESHOLD_CHANGE; strengthens entitlement proof requirement only
